In this lesson you will learn about troubleshooting LCR series and parallel circuits. Also you will troubleshoot a faulted LCR series circuit.
INTRODUCTIONM
Troubleshooting a LCR circuit requires identifying that the circuit is faulted and then isolating the fault to the failed component.
Voltage measurements quickly determine if the circuit is operating correctly.
Resistance measurements isolate the fault to one of the three components.
Let's begin the lesson on LCR CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING.....................

LCR CIRCUIT FAULTSE
The three most common faults in LCR circuits are: open, short and changed value components.
DISCUSSION
The circuit effects of an open, short, or changed value component are different for series or parallel circuits.
Let's discuss series LCR circuit faults first.
